prompt: Revise this customer message to acknowledge the problem without promising an uncertain result: 'Your parcel has not arrived. We have asked the delivery service to investigate. They have not yet given a date. We will send another update by Friday even if the investigation is unfinished.' A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
We’re sorry your parcel has not arrived and understand how frustrating this is. We have contacted the delivery service and asked them to investigate its current location and status. At present, they have not provided an expected delivery date, so we’re unable to confirm when it will arrive.

We will continue to follow up with them and share any information we receive. We also plan to send you a further update by Friday, even if the investigation is still ongoing. Thank you for your patience while we work to clarify what has happened.
